observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black horizontal games console with a curved shell, resting on a wooden surface, with black cables behind it against a painted wall.
Photo 1 shows the same console on a wooden media unit beneath a wall-mounted TV displaying a soccer video game; a round wall clock and a black power brick are also visible.
Both photos carry a "POSTED ON JIJI BRANDON" watermark.
No model number, serial number, or brand name is legible on the console in either photo.

claims.evidence: Photos show a clean exterior but cannot confirm usage hours or wear history.
Distinctive console design visible in photo 0 and photo 1 matches a PlayStation 5.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or has hardware faults
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen or running a game

risks.risk: Missing controller, cables, or original box
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories included with the console

risks.risk: Wrong variant (Digital Edition vs Disc Edition) or incompatible voltage/region for Nigeria
risks.proof: Close-up of the rear model/serial label and power plug

proof_requests: Video of the console turning on and displaying the home screen
Close-up photo of the rear label showing model number and power rating
Photo of all included accessories such as controller, cables, and box
response.reason: The console is identifiable by its PlayStation 5 design, but condition and functionality are unproven, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit without accessories.
